checks: Next quota opens while previous quota survivors remain alive
Continuous mode ignores old automatic wave and group rest timers
Explicit gameplay pause freezes spawning and active run clock
At most one actor is released in an Update, including long frames
All 50 elimination kills account exactly once across four larger quotas
Runner and heavy roles become more frequent in later quotas
Eight reusable actor slots bound active simulation and object allocation
Robot deaths emit one collectible drop per accounted life
Victory sweeps remaining pickups before collecting the immutable result
Collected currency is independent from kill count and persists in the result
